Build a multi-row column-header specification

Source: R/col_header.R
rtf_col_header.Rd

Collects column-header rows, top-to-bottom, into a single object that can be passed to rtftable(col_header = ...). Each argument is one row; a row may be either:

Usage

rtf_col_header(...)

Arguments

...

Header rows in render order (top first).

Value

A list of class "rtf_col_header".

Details

a character vector

one label per data column (legacy form), or

a list of col_cell() objects

for a row with single and/or spanning cells.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
rtf_col_header(
  list(col_cell(1, ""), col_cell(c(2, 5), "Treatment")),
  list(col_cell(1, ""),
       col_cell(c(2, 3), "Drug A"),
       col_cell(c(4, 5), "Drug B")),
  c("Item", "N", "Mean", "N", "Mean")
)
} # }
